name: markdown-corpus-production
complexityPolicy: one production parseFile pass per acceptance file; the markdown analyzer uses one iterative DFS over the block tree, an O(1) byte-offset map from the engine's inline pre-parse, Map-backed symbol dedupe, and Set-backed relationship dedupe — O(block nodes + inline facts), no per-symbol O(n) scans
corpusPolicy: tracked .md files from clean scala3@18df09c (the scala3 language repo, already pinned for the scala analyzer); four named grammar-level limitations (|| in table cell, indented <details> in numbered lists, EOF heading without newline) are excluded and measured separately by markdown-corpus-errors.ts
